recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is recommended; if maintainers want historical clarification for the retired extension-pack artifact, handle that as a separate Extension Pack change.
issue_request: FHIR-8036 was a Published/Persuasive 2015 May FHIR-core Observation change request asking to define the meaning of "condition context" for the genetics assessed-condition extension. The accepted resolution defined it as a diagnosed patient condition with a pertinent association to a condition being tested for and noted that AssessedCondition references Condition.
initial_application: No meaningful FHIR-8036-tagged source commit was found. Historical R4B source contained DiagnosticReport-geneticsAssessedCondition with the older condition-context wording and Reference(Condition) value; the Jira issue later records that the extension was removed in R5.
additional_context: Active current-core DiagnosticReport and Observation sources remain, but searches excluding historical/generated areas found no current DiagnosticReport-geneticsAssessedCondition source or extension URL. Current genomics guidance points to the Genomics Reporting IG and GenomicStudy. The FHIR Extension Pack has a retired/deprecated DiagnosticReport-geneticsAssessedCondition copy with a replacement note for the Genomics Reporting Guide.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source was changed because the current core build no longer owns the old extension; any future clarification to the retired extension definition belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Withdrawn/no-change issue confirming assessedCondition already referenced Condition.
